summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric action RPG; its active slice is Z01, Broken Lantern Road, from the Wayside Fire through the Dripping Gate. The main-place referee stages quests and actors, player and enemy behaviors own combat, and authored scene cells plus procedural generators build the ravine.
places: places/main/ - active Z01 place: Wayside Fire hub, candle road, tollhouse court, Dripping Gate and Bailiff arena; sim.js coordinates quests and actors.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - authored camp, candle-road and court landmarks and dressing, including ruin-road props.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - authored extended road, Dripping Gate and Bailiff arena dressing.
places/main/config.yaml - place look, terrain/material configuration and procedural grass, clover and mushroom layers.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: default place main, player/camera templates, lighting, UI, arrival behavior and desktop/touch input actions.
templates/player.js - player character template composing scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - place referee: ensures Maelin, petitions, enemy pack and Bailiff exist; advances per-player quest/levels and grants the one-time turn-in reward.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - authored Wayside Fire and candle-road/court content.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - authored gate, extended road and Bailiff arena content.
places/main/config.yaml - binds the place's terrain and environmental layers.
shared: scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - runtime combat tuning consumed by player, wax-pack and Bailiff, including guard, boss attacks and ledger/Fray parameters.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - shared HUB/ROAD/COURTS/GATE coordinates and floorDist reference used by terrain, player boundary/path logic and place layout.
scripts/gen/hub-kit.js - vector, transform, mesh and composition helpers for hub prop generators.
scripts/gen/vf-kit.js - seeded RNG and modeling helpers for Veilfall generators.
scripts/gen/shapes.js - shared mesh construction helpers for generated wax, arena and landmark geometry.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy manager and combat helpers reused by scripts/bailiff.js for payout.
world.assets.yaml - registers the external veilfall-design-package aggregate at /cdn/value.6333346fa6808b148d9ba468df826a3a49a29b8a0afb51a66a9e78d477c84abc.md; it is not runtime scripts/lib/data.
notableExports: scripts/terrain.js - heightAt, materialAt; scripts/gen/vf-ruin.js - geometry, collider
ownership: scripts/player.js - per-player hp/edge/tonics, XP/level/gold/kills, quest/inventory/reward fields, movement, death/i-frame state and Afterimage Guard fields.
places/main/sim.js - per-player Z01 quest stage/dialog, kill baseline, level thresholds and claimed['Z01-MAIN-05'] reward; place orchestration state.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy AI/hp/death, player damage, nearby XP/gold/kill payouts and eligible wax shards.
scripts/bailiff.js - boss hp/phases/casts, arena engagement/reset, ledger pillars, walkers and Fray; publishes place.state.boss and records bailiffDownAt.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - gait/seat animation and foot grounding; consumes player faceYaw.
scripts/camera.js - camera zoom distance and smoothed follow position.
scripts/ui.js - renders HUD, dialogue and inventory from player/place state; it does not own gameplay state.
flows: templates/player.js attaches scripts/player.js; onSpawn initializes combat state from combat.yml and update owns movement, attacks, healing and death/respawn.
world.config.yaml maps desktop and touch actions to player inputs; scripts/ui.js provides phone HUD/chips and PACK action → scripts/player.js handles skills and bagOpen.
scripts/player.js uses veilfall-map.js floorDist for reachable click goals and keepOnFloor movement/dash → the hero stays on defined floor and cannot climb banks/cliffs.
scripts/player.js strikes write enemy.state.hp and lastHit → scripts/wax-pack.js resolves ordinary enemy death and pays nearby players XP/gold/kills; eligible kills can award shards.

scripts/wax-pack.js and scripts/bailiff.js check iframesUntil and guardUntil before damaging a player; caught blows consume guardUntil and write riposte → scripts/player.js guardTick ripostes nearby foes.
On a guard catch scripts/player.js emits CATCH FX, shockwave and owner-targeted screenFlash; guard activation emits GUARD FX.
scripts/bailiff.js spawns phase-II ledger pillars and walkers; player attacks lower pillar hp, while intact pillars increase Fray and boss damage taken by players.
scripts/bailiff.js publishes hp/max/phase/engaged/dead/fray/ledgers/cast to place.state.boss → scripts/ui.js renders boss bar and guidance; ledger ignition/Fray emits highlights and FX.
scripts/bailiff.js marks present eligible players bossKilled on defeat and records place.state.bailiffDownAt → places/main/sim.js advances the stage-gated quest and owns one-time reward claiming.
places/main/sim.js spawns petition objects using scripts/petition.js → trigger entry at quest stage 2 adds that petition to player state; five collected petitions advance the quest.
player.state.talk with Maelin → places/main/sim.js stages the quest; kills since killsAt, petition count and bossKilled drive road, tollhouse and boss objectives.
scripts/ui.js reads player quest/combat/inventory/dialogue state and place.state.boss; player faceYaw drives humanoid-locomotion orientation.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire camp props, varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share scripts/gen/hub-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js other than vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks and clutter, varied by parameters/seeds and built with scripts/gen/vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-ruin.js - reused for road and arena broken ashlar walls and iron braziers; params.kind selects wall/brazier, dimensions and seed vary geometry.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing generators sharing scripts/gen/shapes.js.
scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - shared wax character mesh for ordinary pilgrims/deacons and Bailiff, varied by kind and seed.
scripts/grass.js, scripts/clover.js and scripts/mushroom.js - procedural vegetation scatter layers configured in places/main/config.yaml; grass appearance uses scripts/grass-look.js.
migrationNotes: Player attacks directly mutate enemy.state.hp; ordinary-enemy death, XP and kill credit are resolved later by scripts/wax-pack.js, so preserve that handoff.
Quest stage, killsAt, petition IDs and claimed rewards are per-player state; petition triggers count only at stage 2 and ITEM-001 is guarded by claimed['Z01-MAIN-05'].

Boss and ordinary enemy attacks share player guardUntil/riposte; scripts/player.js owns the riposte reaction and must retain this state handoff. design.md records a held-body catch at t+1.0 s inside the 1.4 s window, consuming guardUntil.
The boss HUD consumes place.state.boss projection (including fray and ledgers), not boss internals; retain its published fields when changing boss behavior.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml is runtime tuning (seconds/meters as appropriate); scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js floorDist < 0 defines walkable floor for player boundary/path logic.

The 35-doc design package was removed from scripts/lib/data and survives as the byte-identical aggregate in world.assets.yaml at /cdn/value.6333346fa6808b148d9ba468df826a3a49a29b8a0afb51a66a9e78d477c84abc.md; runtime tuning YAML remains in scripts/lib/data.
